verdict.rationale: Slack has official help articles on exporting workspace data and on its import/export tools, but the pack shows only their titles, not how they work. A community report confirms that Corporate Export can include DMs and private channels, though it requires a legal or compliance justification and Slack's approval. That gating fits the story's 'where policy allows' clause but adds real friction. missing for 10: documented machine-readable export format (e.g. JSON) details, first-party detail on full-history scope and private-conversation export, hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
